justification: While the formal documented procedures place final decisions in human hands, the new audit findings reveal performance-management structures that disincentivize overrides. Reviewers face managerial scrutiny if their override rate exceeds 12%, and interviews confirm this influences their decisions. This compromise to independent human oversight undermines the claim that human reviewers maintain full, unaccountable authority over the final disposition.
evidence_affected: The documented procedure assigns the final case-level decision to the claims reviewer.
Human reviewers determine the final disposition of individual claims.
